Duvo summary: Enterprise Execution OS

Turn business goals into executed outcomes. Duvo is the shared layer that understands how work runs, orchestrates execution across your systems, and measures the business outcome.

Outcomes and guarantee

Duvo targets five business outcomes: take cost out, release cash, protect service, accelerate cycle time, and strengthen control. The public solution library covers logistics, inventory, finance, and fulfillment, including Freight Audit, Inventory Replenishment, Payables Audit, and OTIF Recovery. Every solution is covered by a contracted 5x ROI guarantee. The proposal defines the baseline, measurement window, and sign-off. If the measured result is below five times the total proposal price for the agreed scope, the whole contract is free. See /solutions.

Process Intelligence

Process Intelligence is how Duvo captures and diagnoses the work. It combines screen walkthroughs, AI interviews, and documents into one reviewed process, with exceptions, controls, and opportunities attached. Outputs include a process catalogue, onboarding and training, process improvement, a transformation roadmap, SAP migration evidence, and reliable automation.

Customer evidence and controls

Verified results: Notino released about 40 million euro of working capital as its bonus-reconciliation cycle reduced from 70 days to 15. Rohlik Group protects 2.1 million euro of revenue and 1.4 million euro of margin annually. Pilulka improved availability by 15 percent in two weeks. Duvo holds SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and ISO 42001, supports GDPR requirements, does not train models on customer data, and keeps human approval gates before sensitive actions. See /customer-stories.
